senses.gloss:
लप् 1. लप्, cl. 1. P. लपति (sometimes
also A. लपते when required by the
metre), ललाप, लपितुम्, to chatter, prate, speak,
talk; to whisper; to wail, lament, weep: Caus. ला-
पयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अलीलपत् or अललापत्, to
cause to talk: Desid. लिलपिषति: Intens. लालप्-
यते, लालप्ति, to talk incessantly or excessively,
chatter senselessly, prattle; to bewail, lament; [cf.
Gr. ἔ-λακ-ο-ν, λέ-λακ-α, λά-σκ-ω, λακ-ε-ρό-ς, λα-
κέρυζα, (probably also) ὀλοφύρομαι, according to
some also λάλος, λαλέω (through reduplication, the
final letter of rt. लप् being rejected): Lat. loqu-o-r,
loquax, loquela, Ajus Locu-ti-us, la-mentum;
labium, labrum, lambo: Slav. reka: Lith. su-
rik-ti, rek-iu: Hib. labhraim, ‘I speak;’ labh-
radh, ‘speech, discourse.’]

लपन, अम्, n. the act of speaking, talking;
the mouth.

लपित, अस्, आ, अम्, chattered, spoken, said; (आ),
f., N. of a Śārṅgikā or particular bird (with which
Manda-pāla is said to have allied himself); (अम्),
n. voice, speech.
लाप, अस्, m. chattering, speaking, talking.
लाप लाप, लापिन्, &c. See p. 861, col. 2.

लापिका in अन्तर्-लापिका, f. a sort of riddle or
enigma; [cf. वहिर्-ल्˚.]

लापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking, saying, declaring; be-
wailing, lamenting.

लाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken, &c.; to be
lamented.

लपेटिका लपेटिका, f., N. of a place of pil-
grimage.

लपेत लपेत, अस्, m., N. of a demon pre-
siding over a particular disease of children.

लप्सिका लप्सिका, N. of a kind of prepared
food.

लप्सुद लप्सुद, अम्, n., Ved. = कूर्च, the
beard (of a goat &c.).

लप्सुदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. having a beard, bearded
(said of a goat &c.).
